reviews.body:
## Review verdict: approve and merge

Verified against OpenAI deprecations: `gpt-4.1-nano` shuts down **2026-10-23**, replacement is **`gpt-5.6-luna`** ([deprecations](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations)). Luna supports image input, so it is a valid vision default ([model page](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna)).

### Change quality
- Defaults updated consistently across vision resolution, parse options, compat-guard provider default, and `LlmConfig::default()`.
- Temperature drop in `ImageGuardProvider` for `gpt-5*` / o-series is the right place (pdf2md always sends `0.1`); excluding `gpt-4.1-*` so OCR temp stays for `gpt-4.1-mini` is correct.
- `models.toml` deprecation + replacement wiring is good.

### Test evidence (this review)
- Local: `compiled_openai_vision_default`, API retired-model / vision_model tests, and pdf `temperature_for*` — all pass.
- CI: Migration Guard Layer 2+3 e2e, SPEC-091 typed data-layer e2e + PG matrix, workspace lib, clippy/fmt, release gates, SPEC-013 — pass.
- Postgres integration job: all test steps succeeded (finishing cache teardown).

### E2E / hermetic red on this PR — **not regressions from this change**
- **E2E UI Gate** fails the same 3 specs as current `edgequake-main`:
  - `mission-06-fixes.spec.ts` (graph merge/delete)
  - `spec100-dashboard-cls.spec.ts`
  - `spec159/graph-ask.spec.ts`
  Confirmed on main run https://github.com/raphaelmansuy/edgequake/actions/runs/39381768636 (same trio). 286 passed here.
- **SPEC-163 hermetic**: merge commit has migrations through **214** while `contract_spec150_train_head` still pins **212** — pre-existing main drift, unrelated to model IDs. Follow-up: bump the contract pin (and `compat_serve_max`) to 214 on main.

### Non-blocking follow-ups
1. Add a `gpt-5.6-luna` card to `models.toml` (replacement string alone does not put it in model search).
2. Fix main E2E UI flakes + train-head contract pin separately so Quality Gate Summary / hermetic go green again.

Merging now given shutdown urgency and no PR-caused e2e regression.
